comment: feat(react-charts): add scope-aware focus preservation after data updates, with explicit reset/disable policies for line, vertical bar, gauge, and declarative consumers. Keep semantic target resolution and execution in the charts, including fresh path-line callouts without redundant position resets on blur; remove duplicate story focus restorers. Equivalent data and callback-only updates do not restore focus. Restoration skips non-tabbable targets and respects simultaneous controlled legend updates.
